fit_definition: Shape It Studios sells digital PDF trace-and-cut templates for large outdoor yard art (roughly 2-10ft), printed on tiled pages, traced onto plywood and cut with a jigsaw or router. A listing is a FIT ('yes') if it is a large flat silhouette of one or a few pieces that could be sold as such a template - either a digital pattern/template itself, or a physical finished yard decoration whose subject could be turned into one. 'maybe' if it could work but is unclear (e.g. small size, many intricate parts, painted detail essential). 'no' for anything else (indoor crafts, printables that are not cut patterns, personalised items, clothing, SVG cut files for vinyl machines). licensed_ip is true for sports teams, brands, film/TV/game characters or other trademarks/copyrights.
